runtimeProjection.governance: Unreviewed, conflicting, unperformed, and no-specimen items do not enter diagnosis, treatment, rubric, or scoring evidence. Critical imaging, urinalysis, and pathology are never generated by the LLM.

stages.stage2: Each order returns its own governed state. Source projections and safe normals retain provenance; unperformed/pathology-without-specimen items have explicit status and no fabricated report; undefined/raw objects are suppressed.
stages.stage3: Only released diagnostic-eligible evidence IDs are selectable; safe normals and pending review items are excluded.
stages.stage4: Consult requests and feedback retain validated evidence references; no unreviewed result is promoted.
stages.stage5: Order-by-order treatment feedback remains traceable and records potentially unnecessary checks.
stages.stage6: Structured perioperative feedback remains traceable to released evidence.
stages.stage7: All five representative journeys generated final reports; trajectory review identifies unnecessary unindicated/unperformed checks while percentage remains primary.
